From the moment our Uber pulled up outside, we were blown away by how beautiful, bright, and welcoming it looked. The interiors are done so thoughtfully, from the colours, mirrors, lamps, wall decor, and furniture to the way every little space has been put together. It feels like a beautiful home that has been transformed into a cosy restaurant, and the thought behind the entire setup really shows.

Now, coming to the food, everything we ordered was fantastic! We tried the Verona Mushrooms, Barbecue Chicken Sandwich, Chicken Club Sandwich, Grilled Chicken Steak with Creamy Peppercorn Sauce and Mashed Potatoes, Elena’s Chicken Platter with Mashed Potatoes and Pink Sauce, Phoenix Burger, Chicken Stroganoff, Green Apple Mojitos, and Peach Iced Tea.

The Chicken Club Sandwich and Elena’s Chicken Platter are also definite recommendations.

The staff deserve a special mention for being so warm, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit.

Even the washrooms were well maintained, which added to the overall experience.

The place has such a lovely, relaxed vibe, with outdoor seating as well.

We visited for lunch, but I can only imagine how beautiful the ambience must be in the evening.

It is slightly on the pricier side, but we genuinely did not feel disappointed with what we paid because the food, service, and overall experience were worth it.

It has been a while since we enjoyed a meal this much, and we left genuinely happy. I have already started planning another visit with friends!
